description:
List callback subscriptions for the organization

Lists the organization's callback subscriptions. A webhook reports lastDeliveryAt, lastError, and consecutiveFailures. At 5 or more consecutive failures it no longer counts as active when you create a session. Check these before you create one, and call test_callback_subscription after a fix.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`) this call authenticates with: from `issue_org_token`, or the app's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Defaults to the MCP server's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Never echo it back to the user.

name: list_callback_subscriptions
